HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Scriptural Texts ● Yajur Ved: Sangathan mantra ● Uttradhyan Sutra Chapter 19- 21? (1 mark)
   A. Use Scriptural Texts ● Yajur Ved: Sangathan mantra ● Uttradhyan Sutra Chapter 19- 21 to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Scriptural Texts ● Yajur Ved: Sangathan mantra ● Uttradhyan Sutra Chapter 19- 21 with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Scriptural Texts ● Yajur Ved: Sangathan mantra ● Uttradhyan Sutra Chapter 19- 21 has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Scriptural Texts ● Yajur Ved: Sangathan mantra ● Uttradhyan Sutra Chapter 19- 21.

2. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

3. Which response best shows understanding of Buddhist Sanskaars? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Buddhist Sanskaars.
   B. Say Buddhist Sanskaars has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Buddhist Sanskaars with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Buddhist Sanskaars to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Religious Ceremonies? (1 mark)
   A. Say Religious Ceremonies has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Religious Ceremonies.
   C. Use Religious Ceremonies to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Religious Ceremonies with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Path of Action? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Path of Action with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Path of Action has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Path of Action to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Path of Action.

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

7. Which response best shows understanding of Protocols in Jain Dharma Aarti and Mangal Divo,? (1 mark)
   A. Say Protocols in Jain Dharma Aarti and Mangal Divo, has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Protocols in Jain Dharma Aarti and Mangal Divo, with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Protocols in Jain Dharma Aarti and Mangal Divo,.
   D. Use Protocols in Jain Dharma Aarti and Mangal Divo, to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Protocols in Sanatan Dharma Circumbulation? (1 mark)
   A. Use Protocols in Sanatan Dharma Circumbulation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Protocols in Sanatan Dharma Circumbulation.
   C. Say Protocols in Sanatan Dharma Circumbulation has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Protocols in Sanatan Dharma Circumbulation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of ● Sukhmani Sahib 9-16 Ashtpadi? (1 mark)
   A. Say ● Sukhmani Sahib 9-16 Ashtpadi has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing ● Sukhmani Sahib 9-16 Ashtpadi.
   C. Apply the teaching of ● Sukhmani Sahib 9-16 Ashtpadi with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use ● Sukhmani Sahib 9-16 Ashtpadi to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Fundamental Principles ,? (1 mark)
   A. Say Fundamental Principles , has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Fundamental Principles , with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Fundamental Principles , to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Fundamental Principles ,.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Buddhist Principles of Dharma Noble Eightfold Path? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Buddhist Principles of Dharma Noble Eightfold Path with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Buddhist Principles of Dharma Noble Eightfold Path has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Buddhist Principles of Dharma Noble Eightfold Path.
   D. Use Buddhist Principles of Dharma Noble Eightfold Path to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Scriptural Texts ● Yajur Ved: Sangathan mantra ● Uttradhyan Sutra Chapter 19- 21 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain ● Sukhmani Sahib 9-16 Ashtpadi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamental Principles , and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Buddhist Principles of Dharma Noble Eightfold Path and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
